source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the types of hypotheses (PDF 94-95).

blocks.text: Hypotheses mukhtalif qism ke hote hain, har aik ka apna maqsad. Do sab se aam, null aur alternative hypothesis, har test mein saath kaam karte hain, aur durust hypotheses uljhan kam aur tajzia behtar karte hain.

blocks.caption: Null aur alternative hypotheses
rows: Koi asar, farq ya rishta nahi (default mafrooza)
Asar, farq ya rishta hai (H0 ka ulat)
Data is ke khilaf jaancha jata; sirf mazboot saboot par radd hota. Yeh muwazne ki ghair-janibdar bunyad deta aur bias se bachata.
Jis ki research aam taur par tayeed chahti; tabdeeli ya asar ki numaindagi, mazboot saboot chahiye.

blocks.title: Class activity
blocks.text: Number ya feesad ki kisi surat-e-haal ke liye null aur alternative hypothesis likhein, aur un ki durusti par guftagu karein.

items: Research sawal: Kya parhai ke waqt ki miqdar talaba ke imtihani score par asar dalti hai?
H0: Parhai ke waqt aur imtihani score mein koi numayan rishta nahi.
H1: Parhai ke waqt ki miqdar talaba ke imtihani score par numayan asar dalti hai.

blocks.alt: 'Kya parhai ka waqt imtihani score par asar dalta hai?' research sawal ka dabba do dabbon mein bat'ta: null hypothesis H0 (koi asar ya farq nahi: parhai ke waqt ka score se numayan rishta nahi) aur alternative hypothesis H1 ya Ha (asar ya farq: parhai ka waqt score par numayan asar). Note: test H0 farz kar ke shuru hota, aur us ke khilaf mazboot saboot ka matlab H0 radd kar ke H1 ke haq mein.
blocks.caption: Research sawal aur us ke do hypotheses (7.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: H0 aur H1 ko mil kar tamam imkanat dhanpne chahiye, taake aik ko radd karna doosre ki taraf ishara kare.

items: Wazeh aur mukhtasar: mubham bayan durusti kam karte hain.
Data se qabil-e-test, variables wazeh tay.

blocks.text: Durust bane hypotheses waqt bachate aur qabil-e-aitbaar nataij tak le jate hain.

blocks.prompt: Dukaandar ka daawa hai ke naye display ne rozana ki average farokht Rs 20,000 se zyada kar di hai. H0 aur H1 likhein.
blocks.explanation: H0: naye display ke saath rozana average farokht Rs 20,000 ya kam hai (koi izafa nahi). H1: rozana average farokht Rs 20,000 se zyada hai.

items: H0: koi asar ya farq nahi; default jo test hota.
H1 (Ha): asar hai; sirf mazboot saboot se tayeed.
Achhe hypotheses wazeh, mukhtasar, qabil-e-test aur sawal se mutabiq.
